statement.en: Under any determined law, courses meeting is an equivalence whose classes are basins; a course reaches every returning configuration of its basin, so within finitely many configurations each basin holds one cycle, entered before as many steps as there are configurations.
statement.zh: 任一确定之律下，行程相会是等价关系，其类为势；行程达其势中每一复返之构形，故构形有限时每势一个回环，在构形数之内入之。

laws.en: Within m listed configurations every course enters what returns before step m.
laws.zh: 列出 m 个构形时，每一行程在第 m 步之前入复返之域。

laws.en: The courses of two configurations meet where at some steps they are at one configuration; after meeting they run together, and meeting is reflexive, symmetric and transitive under any determined law.
laws.zh: 二构形之行程于某步同处一构形即相会；相会后同行，任一确定之律下相会自反、对称、传递。

laws.en: A course reaches every returning configuration of its basin; within finitely many configurations each basin holds one cycle.
laws.zh: 行程达其势中每一复返之构形；构形有限时每势一个回环。

hypotheses.en: No axiom; a determined law; finitely many configurations listed where stated.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理；确定之律；所述之处构形有限且列出。

does_not_show.en: How many basins an actual law has.

correspondence.en: Basins of attraction of a finite map: its functional graph splits into components, each with one cycle.
correspondence.zh: 有限映射之吸引域：其函数图分为诸分支，每支一个回环。

detail.en: Its enters_returning is derived from the bound within the count.
detail.zh: 其 enters_returning 由构形数内之界导出。
